layout:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<Page>
  
  
  <Header role="banner" contains="logo,search,nav,profileMenu" sticky="true"/>
  
  
  <Toolbar>
    
    
    <ToggleDetailsButton/>
    
    
    <DarkModeSwitch/>
    
  
  </Toolbar>
  
  
  <MainContent layout="threeColumn">
    
    
    <Column position="left">
      
      
      <Card title="My Recently Viewed" type="list" itemType="document"/>
      
    
    </Column>
    
    
    <Column position="center">
      
      
      <Card title="My Most Viewed Favourites" type="list" itemType="document" hasViewAll="true"/>
      
      
      <Card title="Recently Updated Pages" type="list" itemType="document"/>
      
    
    </Column>
    
    
    <Column position="right">
      
      
      <Card title="Recent Activity" type="activityFeed" itemType="userAction"/>
      
    
    </Column>
    
  
  </MainContent>
  

</Page>
description: Displays recent activity, favorites, and updates for knowledge management. Clean, card-based layout.

layout:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<Page>
  
  
  <Header appName="BookStack" role="navigation" contains="search,mainMenu,userMenu"/>
  
  
  <Sidebar position="left" contains="details,actions" visible="true">
    
    
    <DetailsPanel shows="revision,created,updated"/>
    
    
    <ActionsList items="edit,copy,move,revisions,permissions,delete,watch,favourite,export"/>
    
  
  </Sidebar>
  
  
  <Breadcrumb visible="true" path="Books > Book > Page Template"/>
  
  
  <MainContent>
    
    
    <Title text="Page Template"/>
    
    
    <Description text="Page Description Template"/>
    
  
  </MainContent>
  
  
  <FooterNavigation type="pager" previous="Chapter" next="Page"/>
  

</Page>
description: Displays book page details, actions, and navigation in a clean, minimal layout.
prev_action: From the dashboard click 'Page Template' link
In the 'Leave a comment here' field, type 'I like this template'
